REQ-32CAB23B7018.requirement_text: Build the new experience from small first-party packages: `apps/saas-core` is the Hono API Worker; `apps/saas-shell` is the account/navigation React SPA; `modules/chat` is a separately versioned Chat module with independently built assets and its own API Worker only where needed; shared packages contain only small versioned contracts/SDK primitives.
